lines.t: I have watched you in the silence
Every tear you tried to hide
You were never out of reach
I was there the whole time
When you felt so forgotten
When your world was closing in
I was calling out your name
But you could not hear Me then
Even in your running
Even in your fear
I have never left you
I am always here
I am closer than your breath
I am beating in your chest
Every moment, every step
You are held, you are kept
I have loved you from the start
You are written in My heart
Even when you feel alone
You have never been on your own
I have seen your hidden battles
Every weight upon your soul
You don’t have to carry this
Let Me make you whole
You were never meant for darkness
You were made to walk in light
Turn and look, I’m standing here
I have never left your side
Through every question
Through every fall
I have been the whisper
Calling through it all
I am closer than your breath
I am beating in your chest
Every moment, every step
You are held, you are kept
I have loved you from the start
You are written in My heart
Even when you feel alone
You have never been on your own
Listen… I am here
I am so near
You are Mine
Always Mine
I am closer than your breath
I am life within your chest
Every moment, every step
You are held, you are kept
I have loved you from the start
You are written in My heart
Even now, just turn and see
You have always been with Me
I am here…
I am here…
I am here…
I am here…
I am here…
I am here…
